ns2:section.sectionText: (Professional Research in Action) Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Permission of instructor required to enroll (abishop@uiuc.edu). A core course for the Community Informatics Corps. Other students may register on a space-available basis. All students must receive the instructor's permission to enroll (abishop@uiuc.edu). The class will meet from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. (with an hour break for lunch) on Saturdays at the Puerto Rican Cultural Center in Chicago (2739-41 West Division Street) on the following dates: 9/2, 9/16, 10/14, 10/28, 11/4, 11/18 (10:00-1:00 only), 12/16 (exam day). The course also requires one class meeting on the UIUC campus, during LEEP weekend on Friday, Sept. 29, 6-9 p.m.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
